## Working in this repository

- Setup: Node >=24.12, then `npm install`; `npx playwright install chromium firefox webkit` for browser tests.
- Workspace packages: `@oddkin/docs` (apps/docs), `@oddkin/ai` (packages/ai), `@oddkin/analyzer` (packages/analyzer), `@oddkin/app` (packages/app), `@oddkin/components` (packages/components), `@oddkin/core` (packages/core), `@oddkin/state` (packages/state), `@oddkin/tokens` (packages/tokens), `@oddkin/workbench` (packages/workbench).
- Component layout (detected from published metadata): one folder per component: the class, `<name>.template.ts`, `<name>.styles.ts`, `<name>.definition.ts` (`compose()`), `<name>.define.ts` (the only module that registers), a side-effect-free `index.ts`, and development-only `<name>.examples.ts` (IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md §3.3).
- Component metadata is generated by the build into `packages/ai/oddkin.metadata.json`, `packages/components/oddkin.metadata.json`; never edit it by hand.
- Commands:
  - build: `npm run build`
  - typecheck: `npm run typecheck`
  - test: `npm test`
  - e2e: `npm run test:e2e`
  - lint: `npm run lint`
  - verify: `npm run verify`
  - metadata: `npm run verify:metadata`
- Agent kits: each component package ships one matched to its version (`node_modules/@oddkin/ai/agent/GUIDE.md`, `node_modules/@oddkin/components/agent/GUIDE.md`; written by the build with `node scripts/agent-kit/package-kits.mjs`, `--check` to find stale ones). In this repository, `node scripts/agent-kit/kit.mjs` writes them into `.oddkin/agent-kit/`; add `--check` to find stale kits.
- Order of work, scope, status, and evidence: `IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md` (the priority plan first, then the milestones and §11 continuation), `docs/progress-log.md` (one row per slice), and `docs/verification.md` (record only observed results).
